name: Advanced Fluid Power & Servo-Hydraulic Actuation
summary: High-performance, closed-loop and compact fluid-power actuation, including electro-hydrostatic actuators and hydraulics for legged robots and exoskeletons.

topics.name: Proportional and servo valves: construction and flow-pressure characteristics
Modeling valve-controlled cylinders and motors: hydraulic stiffness and natural frequency
Closed-loop position, velocity and force control of hydraulic actuators
Compact high-pressure hydraulics for legged robots and exoskeletons (integrated and 3D-printed manifolds)
Pneumatic servo control and pneumatic artificial muscles (McKibben)
Hydraulic power units: miniaturisation, power density and thermal limits
Simulation of fluid power systems (Simscape Fluids, Amesim)
